body:
For the agent writing CLI manual docs — net-new / changed CLI surface from this session (all merged to main), please capture:
- aida advisor watch [--dry-run | --once | --triage-only | --poll-interval | --fork-interval] (STORY-586 / TASK-776)
- aida defer <id> --until "<trigger>" + aida undefer <id>; plus --deferred / --all on list / search / history (STORY-584)
- aida record list | prune; plus the processing-record block in aida show (STORY-582)
- aida mailbox retract | delete; plus [mailbox] allow_retract / allow_delete config (STORY-583)
- aida human away | home | presence | status aliases (TASK-770)
- aida status --activity [--since] (STORY-405)
- aida queue list: the terminal-hidden hint now shows ONLY with --all, not the default role view (BUG-517)

Two notes: (1) 'aida <cmd> --help' (clap doc-comments) is the source of truth — track or generate from it, do not hand-transcribe. SPEC-IDs are deliberately kept OUT of --help, so the manual should show none; a leaked SPEC-ID is a bug to flag, not document. (2) Prefer working in docs/ — if you edit cli.rs doc-comments, tell the advisor so merges get sequenced (there is in-flight CLI work and it will conflict). — advisor
